trend_risk.title: Trend & Technical Risk
trend_risk.methodology: Compares current price to 250-day simple moving average (long-term regime), 20-day rate of change (ROC20 momentum), and distance to 3.0x ATR14 trailing volatility stop.
trend_risk.explanation: The stock is trading 8.0% above its 250-day moving average. Technical signal is HOLD with a 0.5% buffer before triggering trailing stop rules.

market_risk.title: Market & Macroeconomic Risk
market_risk.methodology: Calculates 5-year maximum peak-to-trough drawdown, 252-day covariance Beta relative to SPY, annualized realized volatility (std * sqrt(252)), downside capture ratio during negative market days, and stress drawdowns during COVID-19 (Feb-Mar 2020) and 2022 Tech Bear market.
